## Summary

Completed E164 experiment on Kubernetes Discourse engagement rate. Harvested 100 topics, classified 18 as need-related with 13 zero-replies (72.2% unserved). Wilson CI95 upper bound 0.875 fails G3 gate. Comparison with E138 Prometheus Discourse (89.1% unserved, Wilson 0.9365) confirms low engagement is a general property of developer-focused Discourse forums, not Prometheus-specific. G1 and G2 gates pass in both domains. This resolves key uncertainty about whether E138's G3 failure is domain-specific or general, advancing the mission's boundary condition mapping. No candidate generated from this line. Per D083, next experiment should test view-count principle in novel domain not yet covered by the mission's 14 experiments.

## Next
